title: Documentation: module docs, security note, doc-tests
description:
Write complete public documentation for the uuencoding-multi crate.

Deliverables:

1. src/lib.rs crate-level doc comment:
   - What multi-part UUencoding is and its Usenet/email history
   - What this crate does: subject parsing, part collection, TOC detection, reassembly
   - What this crate does NOT do: MIME parsing, message fetching/storing, yEnc
   - Dependency note: callers use mime-tree for MIME parsing, then feed body bytes here
   - Security note: decoded output may be compressed; caller must apply size limits before decompression
   - A brief end-to-end usage example (doc-test that compiles and passes)

2. Each public type and function: /// doc comments explaining:
   - Purpose and invariants
   - Panic conditions (should be: none — document that)
   - Error conditions
   - Any format assumptions (e.g., body_bytes must be UTF-8 or can be arbitrary bytes)

3. At least one runnable doc-test per public function (compile + run in cargo test).

4. RUSTDOCFLAGS='--cfg docsrs -D warnings' cargo +nightly doc must pass with no warnings.

Quality gate:
  cargo fmt
  cargo clippy -p uuencoding-multi -- -D warnings
  cargo test -p uuencoding-multi (all doc-tests pass)
  RUSTDOCFLAGS='--cfg docsrs -D warnings' cargo +nightly doc --no-deps --all-features -p uuencoding-multi

PARENT: MIME-zjr
